title: 第十三章 院隅寒影亲长私语第十四章 宗门历练结伴入山
content_zh:
深秋寒意浸透整座林家府邸，一夜西风过后，满院梧桐叶尽数枯黄，层层叠叠铺满青石地面，风一卷，枯叶打着旋儿掠过廊下，带着挥之不去的萧瑟。天空终日覆着一层灰蒙蒙的薄云，不见暖阳，天地间灵气都变得滞涩稀薄，连白日光线都显得昏暗低沉，一如当下风雨欲来的修行世道。
韩东独居的后院，是整座林家唯一远离纷争、静谧安然的方寸之地。院内一石一木都打理得规整雅致，中央一方青石石台，四周栽种几株灵竹，只是秋霜侵染，竹尖也染上一抹枯黄，平添几分颓意。院中一共四人朝夕起居，日复一日皆是打坐吐纳、翻阅功法，日子枯燥单调，却也暂时安稳。
韩清鸢每日晨昏必至，一身御兽门浅青色宗门劲装，身姿挺拔温婉。她的目光总会不自觉落在闭目修行的陈默身上，情愫直白坦荡，却始终恪守分寸，从不会出声打扰他凝神修行。闲来无事，她便屈膝坐在一旁草地，指尖萦绕一缕柔和御兽灵气，轻轻梳理小雪蓬松如雪的毛发，指尖温柔，又拿出宗门特制的凝灵兽食，一点点投喂。小白狐慵懒蜷缩，通体绒毛干净柔软，始终敛尽周身气息，看上去就是一只温顺无害的寻常灵兽。
数月前，韩东将一名林家底层旁支少女接入院内一同修行。
少女身形格外单薄瘦削，肩头窄弱，仿佛一阵秋风便能将她吹倒。一身林家统一的灰色弟子服早已洗得发白，袖口、下摆全都磨出毛边，衣料单薄，根本抵挡不住深秋寒意。她永远独自坐在院角背光之处，避开所有人的视线，每日天还未亮便准时端坐修行，直至夜深露重，露水打湿发梢也不肯停歇。
她从不与人交谈，遇见同门侧身避让，撞见族中长老垂首躬身，眉眼低垂，永远一副谦卑怯懦的模样。偶尔有嫡系弟子途经后院，见她无依无靠，便出言嘲讽挖苦，言语刻薄伤人。少女始终一言不发，牙关紧咬，指尖死死抠进掌心，将所有委屈、不甘与酸楚全部压在心底，从不辩驳，也从不表露半分怒意。
同为无亲无故、无根无凭的底层修士，陈默将这一切尽收眼底。他从不会当众怜悯，顾及少女仅剩的自尊，只在无人察觉之时默默帮扶：打坐时不动声色挪动身位，将灵气最充裕的上风之地让给她；深夜少女修行岔气、灵气逆行浑身发冷时，隔空渡去一缕温润灵气，悄无声息理顺她紊乱的经脉；遇见嫡系弟子刻意围堵刁难，便默然驻足一旁，无需言语，便足以让那群欺软怕硬的弟子悻悻离去。
后院之外，林家高层对韩东的恭敬，无时无刻不在彰显他碾压全族的恐怖实力。
近来周边宗门战火连绵，杀伐之声不断逼近青阳城，林家危机迫在眉睫。族内三位执掌大权、平日里在宗门内威严赫赫，动辄训斥责罚弟子的筑基长老，每日都会放下身段，亲自步行来到后院拜访。
他们步入院门便收敛一身傲气，腰杆微躬，语气谦和客气，每一句话都礼数周全。哪怕韩东只是静静品茶，眼皮未抬，不曾起身迎接，这群长老也没有半分不悦，全程恭敬以待。客卿无宗族实权，可一身深不可测的修为，足以让林家所有高层俯首。
待到长老尽数离去，庭院重归安静。
韩清鸢缓步走到叔父身侧，望着天边阴沉云层，眉眼盛满忧虑，轻声开口劝诫：“叔父，如今城外战火四起，流窜邪修与亡命散修遍地都是，危机四伏。族里执意安排低阶弟子进山历练，实在太过冒险。”
韩东指尖摩挲茶杯边沿，目光望向院角孤寂的少女，又看向敛神修行的陈默，语气平淡却带着凝重：“我自然知晓风险，可乱世已至，闭门苦修终究是井底之蛙。不让他们亲眼见识外界残酷，日后真正大祸临头，只会毫无还手之力。”
“可院中二人皆是孤身一人，无人庇护，进山极易遇险。”韩清鸢蹙眉担忧。
“我已叮嘱带队执事，暗中稍加照拂。”韩东抬眸看向侄女，出言叮嘱劝诫，亦是对所有人的警示，“清鸢，你也要谨记。修仙大道从来无情，弱肉强食是亘古不变的规矩。乱世之中，善心无用，锋芒易折，唯有藏拙守心，保全自身，才是活下去的根本。过几日宗门传讯抵达，你即刻返回御兽门，切勿在外逗留，切勿插手山野纷争，安稳自保即可。”
韩清鸢重重颔首，将这番劝诫牢牢记在心底。
叔侄二人已然打定主意，留守府中，绝不涉足山野半步，只静静等候历练队伍归来。
秋风穿院，枯叶纷飞，压抑笼罩四方。无人预知，这场看似寻常的浅山历练，会永远带走院中那束卑微求生的微光。

content_en:
The late autumn chill penetrated the entire Lin family mansion. After a night of west wind, the sycamore leaves in the courtyard were all withered and yellow, and the bluestone floor was covered in layers. When the wind blew, the dead leaves swirled past the corridor, bringing with it a lingering desolation. The sky is covered with a thin layer of gray clouds all day long, and there is no warm sun. The spiritual energy between heaven and earth has become stagnant and thin, and even the light of day seems dim and low, just like the current stormy world of spiritual practice.
The backyard where Han Dong lives alone is the only quiet and peaceful place in the Lin family that is far away from disputes. Every stone and tree in the courtyard is neatly and elegantly maintained. There is a bluestone platform in the center, and several spiritual bamboos are planted around it. However, due to the autumn frost, the bamboo tips are also stained with a touch of withered yellow, adding a bit of decadence. A total of four people in the courtyard lived day and night, meditating and reading exercises day after day. The days were boring and monotonous, but they were temporarily stable.
Han Qingyuan would arrive every morning and dusk, dressed in the light blue sect uniform of the Royal Beast Sect, with a tall and gentle posture. Her eyes would always unconsciously fall on Chen Mo who was practicing with his eyes closed. Her emotions were straightforward and frank, but she always adhered to the rules and never made a sound to disturb his concentration in practice. When she had nothing to do, she bent her knees and sat on the grass beside her. A soft beast-controlling aura lingered on her fingertips, and she gently combed Xiaoxue's fluffy snow-like hair. With gentle fingertips, she took out the sect's special spirit-condensing animal food and fed it little by little. The little white fox curled up lazily, its fur all over its body was clean and soft, and it always held back its aura. It looked like a docile and harmless ordinary spiritual beast.
A few months ago, Han Dong brought a girl from a lower-level branch of the Lin family into the courtyard to practice together.
The girl was extremely thin and thin, with narrow shoulders, as if a gust of autumn wind could blow her down. The gray disciple uniform of the Lin family has long been washed and turned white. The cuffs and hem are all frayed. The material is thin and cannot withstand the chill of late autumn. She always sat alone in the backlit corner of the courtyard, avoiding everyone's sight. She would sit on time to practice before dawn every day, and would not stop until late at night when the dew wet her hair.
She never talked to others, she would step aside when she met her fellow disciples, and she would bow her head when she saw the elders of her clan, her eyebrows lowered, and she would always look humble and timid. Occasionally, a direct disciple would pass by the backyard and see her helpless, so they would make sarcastic, mean and hurtful remarks to her. The girl remained silent, clenching her teeth, digging her fingertips into her palms, suppressing all her grievances, unwillingness and sorrow in her heart, never arguing, and never showing any anger.
As low-level monks with no relatives, no roots, and no credentials, Chen Mo had a clear view of all this. He would never show mercy to the girl in public, taking into account the girl's remaining self-esteem, and would only help silently when no one noticed: quietly moving his body while meditating, giving her the upper hand with the most abundant spiritual energy; late at night, the girl practiced Cha Qi, and her spiritual energy was retrograde and muddy. When her body felt cold, a wisp of warm aura flowed through the air, quietly straightening out her disordered meridians; when she saw her direct disciples deliberately blocking her and making things difficult, she would stand aside silently, without the need for words, which was enough to make those bullying disciples leave in anger.
Outside the backyard, the respect that the senior leaders of the Lin family showed towards Han Dong always demonstrated his terrifying power to crush the entire family.
Recently, the surrounding sects have been at war, and the sounds of killings have been approaching Qingyang City. The Lin family is in imminent crisis. The three foundation-building elders who held great power in the clan and who were usually very dignified in the sect and often scolded and punished their disciples would put down their dignity and walk to the backyard to visit them every day.
As soon as they entered the courtyard, they restrained their arrogance, bowed slightly, their tone was modest and polite, and every word was polite and thoughtful. Even if Han Dong just sipped tea quietly without raising his eyelids or getting up to greet him, these elders were not displeased at all and treated him respectfully throughout the whole process. Keqing has no real power in the clan, but his unfathomable cultivation is enough to make all the senior officials of the Lin family bow down.
When all the elders left, the courtyard became quiet again.
Han Qingyuan walked slowly to his uncle's side, looked at the gloomy clouds on the horizon, his eyebrows were filled with worry, and he spoke softlyAdmonishment: "Uncle, wars are raging outside the city, evil cultivators and desperate cultivators are everywhere, and dangers are everywhere. It is too risky for the clan to insist on arranging low-level disciples to go into the mountains for training."
Han Dong rubbed the edge of the tea cup with his fingertips, looking at the lonely girl in the corner of the courtyard, and then at Chen Mo who was practicing meditation. His tone was calm but solemn: "Of course I know the risks, but the troubled times are coming, and practicing hard behind closed doors is a frog in the well. If they are not allowed to see the cruelty of the outside world with their own eyes, they will be unable to fight back when a real disaster strikes in the future."
"But the two of them are alone in the hospital. There is no one to protect them. It is very easy to be in danger when entering the mountain." Han Qingyuan frowned and worried.
"I have told the deacon who leads the team to take care of him secretly." Han Dong raised his eyes to look at his niece, and gave words of admonishment, which was also a warning to everyone, "Qingyuan, you must also remember. The path of cultivating immortals has always been ruthless, and the law of the jungle is the eternal rule. Chaos. In this world, good intentions are useless and sharp edges are easily broken. The only way to survive is to keep your heart and protect yourself. In a few days, the sect's message will arrive. You should return to the Beast Control Sect immediately. Do not stay outside and do not interfere in the disputes in the mountains. Just stay safe. "
Han Qingyuan nodded heavily and kept this advice in mind.
The uncle and nephew had already made up their minds to stay in the mansion and never set foot in the mountains. They just waited quietly for the return of the training team.
The autumn wind blows through the courtyard, with dead leaves flying, and depression surrounds everything. No one could have predicted that this seemingly ordinary mountain experience would forever take away the glimmer of humble survival in the courtyard.
